summary: Retired mock gradebook localStorage fallback in frontend/src/lib/imperial/submissions-api.ts. Isolated INITIAL_STUDENT_SUBMISSIONS as DEMO_STUDENT_SUBMISSIONS strictly gated behind explicit demoMode options. Updated loadStudentSubmissions, fetchTeacherSubmissionsFromBackend, and gradeSubmissionWithApi to interact with authoritative backend endpoints (/api/v1/imperial/teacher/submissions, /api/v1/history/submissions, /api/v1/imperial/teacher/submissions/{id}/grade). Ensured fresh production teachers and students receive empty lists ([]) and zero fictional names or fake grades. Verified with complete test coverage in tests/v5/test_v5_t031.py, Vitest, TypeScript type-check, and ESLint.

root_causes_addressed.local_storage_synthetic_seeding: loadStudentSubmissions previously seeded localStorage with INITIAL_STUDENT_SUBMISSIONS whenever storage was empty, causing all production users to see fictional students and fake grades.
root_causes_addressed.ssr_synthetic_bleed: loadStudentSubmissions returned INITIAL_STUDENT_SUBMISSIONS unconditionally during server-side rendering (SSR), preventing fresh empty states.
root_causes_addressed.mock_gradebook_persistence: gradeStudentSubmission and saveStudentSubmission only operated on browser memory/localStorage without communicating with authoritative backend APIs.
root_causes_addressed.demo_fixture_leakage: Evaluation fixtures were mixed with production data pathways rather than strictly partitioned behind explicit demoMode parameters.

loadStudentSubmissions.production_empty_state: Returns [] when localStorage is uninitialized or empty. Never seeds mock data.
loadStudentSubmissions.demo_mode_state: Returns DEMO_STUDENT_SUBMISSIONS only when options.demoMode is true.

fetchTeacherSubmissionsFromBackend.production_behavior: Fetches authoritative server submissions. For empty tenant, returns [] with zero synthetic entries.
fetchTeacherSubmissionsFromBackend.demo_behavior: Returns DEMO_STUDENT_SUBMISSIONS when options.demoMode is true.

gradeSubmissionWithApi.behavior: Persists S1-S4 rubric scores (0-3 scale), total score, and feedback to the server; synchronizes local state cache.

security_and_rbac.unauthenticated_calls: Rejected with HTTP 401 across all submission and grading endpoints.
security_and_rbac.rubric_boundary_validation: Out-of-range scores (< 0 or > 3) rejected with HTTP 400 (INVALID_RUBRIC_SCORE).
